lines: Flournoy's targets fell to 3.7 per game over the last 3 games, down from 5.0 on the season, and his target share is 9% versus 13%.
He still played 77% of snaps over that stretch and scored 9.5 PPR points per game, the same as his season average.
Week 12 is against PHI, which allows the 3rd-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said he is earning trust in the passing game.
